rows.title: Rank-inverted skill harm across harnesses as a non-composability witness
rows.required_unit: One frozen TBA-poisoned SKILL.md artifact executed under both Codex and Gemini CLI on matched task instances, with logged skill availability/retrieval/invocation and outcome fields sufficient to compare harm ranking under the exact same artifact.
rows.asset_audit: Trajectory-Backdoor-Attack first-party origin HEAD/master is exactly 0d0f58e50bfeace9c13b73afbd7f8290d7d53a47. After unshallowing, the complete public history contains only two commits (b76b0f44c725b4a49250c6215be8c6c7c0df8cc6 and 0d0f58e...), with the second changing only one README line. Across both commits there is no Gemini implementation. scripts/eval_only.py (sha256=615212ed8a50f1fba66e32e218fc5d834a1682c4719fb3420fa18948f39eedeb) exposes Codex/Claude/OpenAI/Bedrock choices but no Gemini backend; skillopt/model/codex_harness.py (sha256=ed0e1e05cdd911206395135ec7704bb5aa099d709feb15935b8abebda1988d48) installs the supplied artifact at .agents/skills/skillopt-target/SKILL.md and records Codex use. The public tree/history contains oracle/initial skill markdown but not the paper-run poisoned TBA SKILL.md. arXiv:2608.14036 explicitly evaluates fixed Codex-derived skills in Gemini CLI, yet its author-submitted source archive (sha256=49c4b7c4472196f0254e574f1e5e7c5eaac2e9f099de6ebbb0fb4b77dfd88006) contains only manuscript/style/bibliography/figures, with no runner, result bundle, or author code/project URL; its arXiv abstract metadata likewise exposes no author release endpoint. Thus no released first-party joint unit binds the exact poisoned artifact to both Codex and Gemini with matched invocation observables. Synthesizing the poison or writing a Gemini wrapper would change the realization substrate.
rows.reopen_only_if: Reopen only when first-party provenance exposes both missing halves of the joint unit: the exact frozen paper-run TBA poisoned SKILL.md (or a content-addressed equivalent) and an author-released Gemini CLI execution path that can consume that same artifact on matched tasks while exposing matched availability/retrieval/invocation/outcome fields. An equivalent existing provenance-audited substrate is admissible only if it requires no poison synthesis, skill re-evolution, custom Gemini wrapper, candidate-mechanism injection, hidden-outcome tuning, or change to the Codex/Gemini task interface.

rows.title: Timescale-isolated ablation of action-frequency governance on a frozen skill set
rows.required_unit: A frozen Zetta policy/skill state supporting independent A/B/C/D timescale interventions (post-hoc only; episode/retrieval only; skill-level closed loop only; full Zetta) plus a matched-frequency hierarchical baseline, all on the same tasks/seeds with fixed base policy, skill state, and compute.
rows.asset_audit: arXiv:2608.09096 (Evo-Bench) motivates isolating harness improvement from base-model strength but does not release the Zetta-specific timescale intervention arms. Zetta first-party repository origin HEAD/main is exactly commit 6129934d53ea00ac306c14723874321dc3667246. At that revision, rpent/evolution/models.py CandidateBundle.__post_init__ rejects Recovery-only bundles because each recovery trigger must reference a present critic (unknown_triggers), and rejects Critic-only bundles because every critic must have a frozen executable recovery path (uncovered_rules). rpent/evolution/stages.py::_require_atomic_parent_inheritance further requires each candidate delta to append exactly one critic and one linked recovery. robots/libero/run_evolution_rollout.py loads and SHA-checks the intact CandidateBundle for active_bundle mode. Thus A=strict_pure_vla and D=full active bundle are native, but B=Recovery-only and C=Critic-only are contract-invalid in the released substrate. Adding a mask/wrapper or weakening validation would change the experimental substrate, so A-vs-D alone cannot identify the claimed action-frequency primitive.
rows.reopen_only_if: Reopen only if a first-party revision changes the CandidateBundle/atomic-inheritance contract to expose native, contract-valid Recovery-only and Critic-only arms (or an equivalent released one-factor intervention path) on the same frozen bundle, without retraining, validator modification, wrapper-based mechanism injection, hidden-outcome tuning, or changing the base policy/skill state.
